blocks.body:
# FloodGuard Controlled Three-Model Experiment - Gate Evidence Report

The experiment remains fail-closed. The two Sentinel-1 product identities and SAFE checksums are verified, but a signed acquisition-authority receipt, qualified reference authority and terms, independent reviewer calibration, immutable holdout evidence, signed qualified reference-cell evidence, and completed three-model evidence are absent. No model-comparison metrics are reported as real evidence.

## Technical summary

The governed Sentinel-1 pre/post pair re-hashes exactly to the acquisition registry. No externally keyed catalog and licence allowlist receipt authorizes the editable acquisition manifest. The reference-mask candidate is not qualified and its product-specific permissions remain unresolved. Reviewer calibration, frozen holdout, signed qualified reference-cell evidence, and completed three-model evidence are missing; therefore model comparison, decision-layer use, FPPS use, and warning claims remain prohibited.

## Key findings

Three machine-verifiable Sentinel-1 source controls pass. Six authority, reference, review, holdout, reference-cell, and model-evidence control groups remain blocked. A metric value of zero would falsely imply measured performance, so IoU, Dice/F1, precision, recall, area error, Brier score, and calibration are intentionally absent rather than zero-filled.

## Scope, data, and metric definitions

Scope is the governed Mae Sai event package. A real comparison requires a deterministic SAR baseline, the weak-label logistic model, and an isolated GeoAI U-Net/FPN candidate evaluated on the same valid pixels inside immutable spatial holdout polygons against one qualified binary reference mask. IoU is TP/(TP+FP+FN); Dice/F1 is 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); precision is TP/(TP+FP); recall is TP/(TP+FN). Area error is predicted flood area minus reference flood area and is also reported as a percentage of reference area. Brier score is the mean squared difference between class-1 probability and the binary reference. Calibration is reported with fixed probability-bin predicted-versus-observed rates plus expected calibration error. Error review categories are false-wet, false-dry, permanent-water confusion, radar shadow or layover, terrain effects, temporal mismatch, and reference-boundary ambiguity.

## Methodology

The audit checks immutable product IDs, source identity, acquisition timestamps, assumptions, SHA-256 digests, explicit use permissions and timing, reference authority, and reviewer roles and calibration. Spatial holdout membership must be re-derived from descriptor-bound geometry, membership, and signed equal-area grid-contract bytes; physical cell area comes from the affine determinant, and cell IDs, indices, and centers must match exactly. Each signed model-run receipt must bind one strict lane-specific contract for the deterministic SAR baseline, weak-label logistic model, or pinned GeoAI candidate. Any missing or substituted required control blocks downstream execution and promotion.

## Limitations and robustness

UNOSAT product 3991 is preliminary and not field validated; the discovered public artifact is a map product, not an accepted project reference mask. The local manual reference package has no accepted authority or calibrated independent review. These are evidence gaps, not model-performance results.

## Next steps

1. Obtain the product-specific permissions and externally signed catalog/licence allowlist receipt, then name the reference authority, reviewer A, distinct reviewer B, and adjudicator C.
2. Freeze a qualified reference mask plus immutable spatial holdout polygons, the exact projected-metre equal-area grid contract, affine-derived cell membership, signed reference-cell labels and error strata, checksums, and trusted signatures.
3. Complete blinded reviewer calibration and issue a passing receipt before producing the three strict lane contracts and signed model-run manifests with pre-holdout thresholds.

## Further questions

Which agency or qualified external authority can accept the reference-mask specification? Who will serve as two independent reviewers and adjudicator? What retention and attribution terms govern the resulting labels?

accessIssues.message: An externally keyed catalog and licence allowlist receipt must bind the exact product IDs, rights, and artifact hashes.
A qualified reference-mask authority and accepted reference mask are required.
Two independent reviewers, an adjudicator, blinded calibration evidence, and a passing receipt are required.
Immutable spatial holdout polygons, an exact signed equal-area grid contract, affine-derived cell membership, and checksums are required.
Externally signed qualified reference-cell labels and documented error strata must be bound to the accepted mask and holdout.
Completed baseline, weak-label, and GeoAI evidence must be bound to the same cleared inputs and holdout.
